stages.representation: 168 convergent inline-PTX kernels covering every tcgen05.ld.red leaf (84 32x32b leaves and 84 16x32bx2 leaves across x2..x128: 28 u32, 28 s32, and 112 f32 (min/max, each with and without .abs and .NaN)); each stores its first register and its reduction result
stages.detail: The 28 imported NVVM_TCGEN05_LD_RED records have no NVPTX selections in the pinned dump, and LLVM lowers only the .u32 integer spelling, so the admitted route is inline PTX for every u32, s32, and f32 leaf. Pinned llc at -O0 accepted the 238,806-byte fixture (source SHA-256 9f69a85407a54f6ab24b12da3800ede2fae939577fdbc6859089a088d9ddae6b); every target retained 168 entry kernels and 168 exact tcgen05.ld.red instructions, with 16x32bx2 leaves using half-split offset 16. PTX SHA-256: sm_103a/+ptx88 b2c14e0cbf6d18779f29e535aca768eca125b194e2240d653555060a78f46989; sm_110a/+ptx90 4cca18470b879cc28532cfc6b7d80d102df65331394e2718556d16a990d03cac. Separately proven family-target PTX SHA-256: sm_103f/+ptx88 76b3605c99c23b84c17e247dea0416ac91c65d6e8de1a96716c62e556e3a2c40; sm_110f/+ptx90 e3b321b2a18141d20db7603f32afc53157e1a139f0186332802156e71c7d7d10.

stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 ptxas cubin SHA-256: sm_103a bd1b9be766482316f6a15238491f40eda910ab6d56b5c93abde066a321f8fca3; sm_103f 8721dffed7dcdce30ae4345abe38db41c8eab4a0bc7e1ec6e6953848cc70ba6d; sm_110a 67cfc06205633cda25c228f26a5ee7b5b3417adb7d1330b5766172e2309fa222; sm_110f 1d6b7132bd22bc6489474e4033e705f9b2b497f061a1993c8d5dd42a32f2a583. Each cubin has 168 entry symbols; nvdisasm found exactly 252 LDTM instructions: one LDTM.STAT per 32x32b leaf and one t0_t15 base half plus one t16_t31 half at base+0x10 per 16x32bx2 leaf, with the reduction encoded as .MIN/.MAX (126 each), .S32 (42), .F32 (168), ABS (84), and .NAN (84).
